coord_file_meta.decision_head: TypedDecisionHead = single nn.Linear(212, 4*10); logits affine in S
coord_file_meta.notes: Measurement only: frozen checkpoints, no training, no optimizer, no weight modification. Primary competitor a* is chosen at S_(t-1) (fixed local reference); m_commit_altstar uses a* recomputed at S_t as a sensitivity check. rho_margin defined only when dm_cand > 0.001. alpha* values are exact for the linear readout and are empirical local decision-boundary statistics, not model thresholds.

metadata.statistical_discipline_note: Transition-level tables/plots are descriptive (transitions within sequences are dependent). Independent inference is seed-level (n=5): paired failure-vs-success within model and paired E-vs-F. Cohen's dz bands are conventional; sign consistency is k/5. alpha* values are exact local decision-boundary statistics for the linear readout, not model thresholds.

E_candidate.note: alpha*_margin = minimal alpha along S_prev + alpha (C-S_prev) with non-negative margin vs the fixed competitor a*; alpha*_full = minimal alpha with the full argmax = y. Exact (linear head). Empirical local decision-boundary statistics, NOT model thresholds.

F_combined.note: alpha*_margin = minimal alpha along S_prev + alpha (C-S_prev) with non-negative margin vs the fixed competitor a*; alpha*_full = minimal alpha with the full argmax = y. Exact (linear head). Empirical local decision-boundary statistics, NOT model thresholds.

E_candidate.note: q_i = (w_y - w_a*)_i f_i (C_i - S_prev_i); sum_i q_i = dm_commit exactly because the readout is affine. No nonlinearity precedes the logits, so the decomposition is exact (not a local Jacobian approximation).

F_combined.note: q_i = (w_y - w_a*)_i f_i (C_i - S_prev_i); sum_i q_i = dm_commit exactly because the readout is affine. No nonlinearity precedes the logits, so the decomposition is exact (not a local Jacobian approximation).

analysis_4_coordinate_attribution.note: Per-coordinate arrays are stored for the primary set. Coordinates are described as decision-contributing / readout-relevant, never as register coordinates.

E_candidate.note: Contribution-weighted gate = sum_i |q_cand_i| f_i / sum_i |q_cand_i| (gw_all); gw_pos / gw_neg weight the positive / negative candidate decision contributions; gw_mag weights by candidate latent movement |C_i - S_prev_i|.

F_combined.note: Contribution-weighted gate = sum_i |q_cand_i| f_i / sum_i |q_cand_i| (gw_all); gw_pos / gw_neg weight the positive / negative candidate decision contributions; gw_mag weights by candidate latent movement |C_i - S_prev_i|.

E_candidate.rule_note: U supported if >=2 of {lower delivered fraction, lower absolute delivered margin, lower positive-weighted gate} hold with consistent sign across >=4/5 seeds. R supported if the share of failures with scalar-equivalent sufficient transfer (rho >= alpha*_full) is >= 0.10 (a deliberately permissive non-triviality bar; the observed values are ~0.44-0.48, far above it) or if candidate decision-direction alignment is lower on failures with >=4/5 sign consistency.

F_combined.rule_note: U supported if >=2 of {lower delivered fraction, lower absolute delivered margin, lower positive-weighted gate} hold with consistent sign across >=4/5 seeds. R supported if the share of failures with scalar-equivalent sufficient transfer (rho >= alpha*_full) is >= 0.10 (a deliberately permissive non-triviality bar; the observed values are ~0.44-0.48, far above it) or if candidate decision-direction alignment is lower on failures with >=4/5 sign consistency.
